title: The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain
summary: Frank Rosenblatt published The Perceptron: A Probabilistic Model for Information Storage and Organization in the Brain in Psychological Review in November 1958. The paper develops a theory for a hypothetical nervous system called a perceptron and presents it as a quantitative statistical approach to recognition, memory, and learning.
significance: A directly documented 1958 research publication on the perceptron, providing a primary-source milestone for the history of computational learning and neural-network research without treating later influence or ancestry as established by chronology alone.

verification.note: Title, author, journal, volume, issue, pages, DOI and November 1958 publication month are verified against the APA DOI record and PubMed. Cornell University archival and institutional records corroborate Rosenblatt's Cornell Aeronautical Laboratory role and contemporaneous 1958 perceptron work. No exact publication day, invention date, causal ancestry, influence relationship, or development geography is asserted.
